title: Differential audit sampling + KMS call-path reconciliation for RBAC v2 operator scope
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: Reduce sensitive-audit volume while preserving forensic fidelity and ensuring per-call KMS provenance for operator-scoped actions. This PR implements a differential audit-sampling layer (route + risk aware) integrated with an end-to-end KMS call-path reconciler to ensure any sampled event carries provable KMS metadata that can be traced back to the operator credential used. Changes include a sampling policy engine, hooks in the RBACv2 enforcer to emit sampling signals, and a background reconciler that annotates audit events with KMS proofs and retries failed attestations. Checklist: - [x] Sampling engine core + config (feature flagged) - [x] RBAC enforcer hooks for per-request risk tagging - [x] KMS call-path reconcilier with exponential backoff and backfill - [x] Integration tests for sampled vs full-audit behavior - [x] Docs + migration notes - [x] Performance microbenchmarks to validate <3% p50 overhead Related tickets/links: Linear ENG-4820, SEC-900; design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4820/differential-audit-sampling-design; compliance note (internal): https://redwood.internal/docs/compliance/kms-provenance. Rollout: feature gated behind runtime flag rbacv2.diff_audit_sampling; default off for enterprise accounts. When enabled, low-risk routes use probabilistic sampling, high-risk routes (policy change, KMS key ops, operator escalation) are always retained. The reconciler runs asynchronously and attaches kms_proof:{provider,region,key_id,nonce,signature} when available. If reconciliation fails after configured retries the audit event is marked audit_status:reconciler_failed and forwarded to a high-priority fanout for compliance reviewers. Backwards compatibility: existing audit consumers see an added metadata block but retain old fields. Migration note: operators that rely on 100% audit capture must set force_full_audit:true per-route in console before enabling this flag.

Security review (automated): no cryptographic misuse detected but recommend rotating the temporary nonce format; addressed in c2d9f44 commit.
testing_notes: Integration: deterministic replay harness with seeded RNG (CI-only seed). Added unit tests for sampler policy evaluation (edge cases: 0% and 100% routes). Manual: ran replay with 10M events on perf-lab to validate overhead and reconciler throughput. Observed reconciler steady-state of ~1200 events/s on a 4-vCPU worker with median attach latency 85ms.
risk_assessment: Risk: medium. This changes audit volume semantics and adds async reconciliation which temporarily leaves some events without KMS proofs until reconciliation completes. Mitigations: feature flag, console override to force full-audit, reconciler retry/backoff, high-priority fanout for failed reconciliations and alerting. Security: signed KMS proof attached; crypto-review completed.
release_notes: - Introduces differential audit sampling (feature-flagged) to reduce audit storage cost while preserving forensic coverage for high-risk routes. - Adds KMS call-path reconciler to attach provenance proofs to sampled audit events. - New runtime flags + per-route force_full_audit override. - Metrics: reconciler.failure_count, reconciler.attach_latency, sampler.evaluation_time.
